method: Sequential matched baseline and candidate. Three fresh implicit wallets per arm. Same custody versions. One SDK and harness serve both arms. The Gateway completion command and Console directory update differ. Both arms include the earlier background terminal cleanup. Only the NEAR signer is loaded. First signature is an independently verified SDK Ed25519 message without account funding.
scope: Existing staging testnet resources. No new infrastructure or package release.

protocolFinding.result: SDK payload signatures verify, but the standard NEP-413 payload signatures do not.

limits: The focused browser E2E used local Worker roles, virtual WebAuthn, and stubbed NEAR RPC. It did not verify a hosted deployment or live chain submission.
The native VM launcher failed before browser execution because its fresh SigningWorker schema checker rejects three existing Ed25519 tables. That unrelated checker is unchanged.
No hosted services were changed. The SDK and Router encoding change requires a coordinated release; no legacy wire fallback was added.
The shared checkout remains on ml-dsa. Its index and files were untouched; the completed fix is committed on dev through an isolated index and compare-and-swap ref update.

changes: Send one exact wallet, home and ceremony completion command to Console without a directory preflight.
Use UPDATE RETURNING for the fresh terminal transition. Read the row only on retry or conflict.
Keep tenant and writer scope, placement state, ceremony ownership, passkey cancellation exclusion and terminal replay checks.

directoryFreshCompletion.scope: Directory portion only, derived from the exercised production call path. No hosted latency estimate.

outcome: Finalization HTTP median fell from 2542.710 ms to 2405.264 ms (137.446 ms, 5.405%). Home completion median fell from 375 ms to 275 ms (100 ms, 26.667%). The full registration target remains unmet.
excludedAttempts: An initial upload found the dry-run bundle in a nested output directory. Gateway upload did not succeed; the custody cohort was restored before retry.

An initial baseline deployment incorrectly copied API placement settings into Wrangler format. Post-deploy inspection found placement missing. Those samples are excluded. Explicit Wrangler region settings were restored and both accepted arms were rerun with placement readback checks.
limitations: Three sequential samples per arm establish neither percentiles nor a maximum guarantee.
Authenticated Yao and wallet-commit metrics sum corresponding HTTP durations per sample, never stage medians.
Browser registration-to-signature time includes automation and UI settlement. Fresh wallets do not prove cold Workers or DOs.
Gateway-wide D1 and backend Console call counts remain unknown. Application timers omit some CPU work.
Existing APAC home hints remain. Actual physical colocation was not remeasured.
The unchanged Yao execute path was also faster in the candidate arm. Do not attribute the full end-to-end difference to the directory change.
Both arms include Phase 6Z background cleanup. This comparison does not measure Phase 6Z separately.
The frozen SDK uses an incorrect NEP-413 payload layout. These are verified SDK message signatures, not successful standards interoperability checks.
